# Teacher Task Force

> A UNESCO-led international initiative advancing teacher quality and SDG 4 Education 2030 through knowledge production, advocacy, and policy support across global education systems.

The Teacher Task Force operates as a cross-cutting initiative bringing together UNESCO, ILO, and international partners to address teacher shortages and strengthen teacher agency in achieving Sustainable Development Goal 4. The organization combines research, advocacy, and direct country support through evidence-based policy frameworks.

## Key Topics

- SDG 4 - Education 2030
- Teacher advocacy
- Teacher quality and shortage
- Education policy
- Knowledge dissemination
- Teacher agency
- Professional development
- UNESCO partnerships
- Global Report on Teachers
- Policy Dialogue Forum
- Teacher Policy Development Guide
- Oslo Declaration
- World Teachers' Day
- Regional policy learning
- Knowledge Hub

## About the Organization

- [Home](https://teachertaskforce.org): Teacher Task Force homepage covering SDG 4 advocacy and global education initiatives
- [Our Mission](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/our-mission): Mission statement emphasizing qualified teachers as key to SDG 4 Education 2030 framework
- [About the TTF](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/about-ttf): About page describing TTF mission aligned with Oslo Declaration and SDG 4 Education 2030
- [History](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/history): Organizational history from Dakar World Education Forum addressing teacher recruitment gaps

## Leadership & Governance

- [Members](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/members): Member directory and task force composition with UNESCO and international partnerships
- [Steering Committee](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/steering-committee): Steering Committee leadership and governance structure across Ghana, South Africa, Uganda
- [Secretariat](https://teachertaskforce.org/who-we-are/secretariat): TTF Secretariat staff and contact directory based at UNESCO Paris headquarters

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [Knowledge Production and Dissemination](https://teachertaskforce.org/what-we-do/Knowledge-production-and-dissemination): Knowledge Hub, Global Report on Teachers, and Policy Dialogue Forum for SDG 4 monitoring
- [Advocacy](https://teachertaskforce.org/what-we-do/advocacy): Teacher advocacy campaigns and World Teachers' Day initiatives supporting SDG 4 goals
- [Country Support](https://teachertaskforce.org/what-we-do/national-and-regional-policy-learning): Country support using Teacher Policy Development Guide with regional policy learning
- [Cross-cutting Initiatives](https://teachertaskforce.org/cross-cutting-initiatives): Cross-cutting initiatives integrating knowledge production, advocacy, and policy learning

## News & Events
